{{Quote|Reneget Vause is almost spacer superstition; something to tell the kids.''"<br />"''Just because Vause lurks in what your people quaintly refer to as the "Unknown Regions" doesn't mean he does not exist.|Mako and Aristocra Hadro|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Reneget Vause''', known as the '''Serpent of the Void''', '''Sarlacc in Scales''', or '''Hunter of Worlds''', was a dangerous [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pirate/Legends|Pirate]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] who was active during the [[Galactic War]].

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Reneget stalked the farthest reaches of space. Eventually, he became the target of a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]]. After the first encounter, the bounty hunter tracked down his other captains and rival in order to lure him into a fight. In the end, the bounty hunter had the choice of either capturing him alive and stripping him of all his Scorekeeper points, or fighting him to the death and letting him die honorably.
